title: New lower bounds for the degree-diameter problem from generalized quadrangles and hexagons
description: We give two constructions of large graphs of small diameter from generalized polygons. The first, for diameter three, removes from the symplectic quadrangle W(q) a point, the points collinear with it and the lines through it, and adds Cayley edges on the orbits of the transvections with that centre. We prove that these fibre extensions have diameter three whenever a single graph on q2 vertices does, and that when it does not, a matching on the points can repair the pairs it leaves at distance four. The second attaches new vertices to incidence graphs of generalized quadrangles and hexagons: recursively, in towers of hexagons, and to the compound graphs of Gomez and Fiol after deleting some matching edges at a set of pairwise non-collinear points or pairwise non-concurrent lines, which we show keeps the diameter. The constructions improve the known lower bounds for the degree-diameter problem at the 14 pairs (14, 3), (15, 3), (19, 3), (20, 3), (13, 4), (14, 4), (15, 4), (17, 4), (18, 4), (19, 4), (11, 6), (13, 6), (15, 6) and (16, 6).
